lines.text: The LORD will make Jerusalem a heavy stone, and all who heave it away will be severely injured.
The LORD will make Judah's clans like a firepot in a woodpile and will save their tents first.
They will look on the One they have pierced and mourn, with wailing like Hadad-rimmon's in the plain of Jezreel.
A fountain will cleanse David's house from sin, and the LORD will erase the names of the idols.
Two-thirds in the land will be cut off and perish, but the LORD will refine the remaining third like iron.
